game_concept: A speed quiz set in Mystic Forest – Owl Roost, a night-time owl roost: the wood elf archer must handle bog toads while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Iteration Tracer: Predict how many times a loop body runs before the clock stops.
theme: Mystic Forest – Owl Roost: a night-time owl roost
core_gameplay_loop: In Owl Roost, repeat each round: Predict how many times a loop body runs before the clock stops. Each round, a new spirit lanterns challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the trace_score value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 440 points of spirit lanterns by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 440, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 7 (applied tier): Iteration Tracer
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Iteration Tracer' (Week 5 slot 12), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Owl Roost'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mystic Forest
region.mood: airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how trace_score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against bog toads in Owl Roost.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 440 within 38 seconds.
